title: The Real Pete Hegseth Scandal Is Much Bigger Than You Think 😳 | Chris Cillizza
description:
Pete Hegseth’s management of the Pentagon is becoming a major national-security story—and not enough people are paying attention. 🚨

After months of reported tension with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned. Before leaving, Driscoll reportedly went directly to President Trump with concerns about the Army’s future, the growing dysfunction at the Pentagon, and the number of senior military leaders being fired, forced out, or bypassed.

This isn’t just Washington drama. The U.S. is facing an active conflict with Iran, supporting Ukraine against Russia, and confronting threats around the globe. Yet the Army has been left without a chief of staff, and the number of active-duty four-star generals has fallen sharply. ⚠️

Hegseth talks constantly about a “warrior mentality,” toughness, and remaking the military. But the more important question is whether his approach is hollowing out the senior leadership America needs at a moment of real danger. Is the Pentagon becoming less prepared to deal with the challenges ahead? 🇺🇸

In this video, I break down Driscoll’s resignation, the reported purge of top military officers, and why this story matters far beyond the personalities involved.
